turn.context: The approved summary: facts muted because they are the hospital’s, the five parts as pieces, worth beside cost with no ratio stated, the four numbers that would finish it.

text: Here is the whole thing on one page.
bullets: Everything we found is yours. One team does both jobs, one after the other. Patients reach a bed between 4:30 and 8 PM.
The gain is ₹1.5 to 2 crore a year. We used your ₹8,000 per bed a day. Your total daily revenue says it should be higher.
The cost is ₹17 to 19.5 lakhs a year. The Discharge Executives are not in that yet.
chat.pointer: Pick a finding, a piece or a box to open it.
chat.invite: Occupancy will not go up. The shorter stay is already inside the gain, counted once. Shall we talk about a first step?
chat.note: Your facts, five parts, worth beside cost.
prompts: Ok, proceed to a first step
Why should the gain be higher?
Which part would you start with?

blocks.label: What we found: your facts, not ours

items.line: Each bed earns nothing in that time

blocks.caption: Muted, because they are yours. Nothing in this row is our proposal.

sheets.title: One team, both jobs
sheets.text: You told us one team runs discharges and admissions. Its own clock times showed them running one after the other.

sheets.title: A bed only after 4:30 PM
sheets.text: Patients arrive at about 1 PM. They reach a bed between 4:30 and 8 PM.

sheets.title: 4 to 5 hours between bills
sheets.text: From one patient’s bill closing to the next patient’s bill opening on the same bed. Up to 8 hours on a bad day.

sheets.title: Automations
sheets.text: Six steps from one engine, reading data you already hold. Needs read access and discharge automated first.

sheets.title: Process changes
sheets.text: Admissions and discharges run together. Four smaller changes and two owners hold it up.

sheets.title: People and buy-in
sheets.text: Six teams confirm what the system worked out. The Head of Operations approves the flows.

sheets.title: Teams and roles
sheets.text: Two managers, three Admissions Executives settled, Discharge Executives waiting on your pattern.

sheets.title: Measures
sheets.text: Eight numbers weekly. Six new, three of them early warnings. Dead bed time first.

sheets.title: Bills start hours earlier
sheets.text: Each bed earns from earlier in the day. That is where the ₹1.5 to 2 crore comes from. The operation theatre is left out.

lines.label: Not counted
lines.value: Occupancy. It does not go up.

items.label: What it is worth
items.sub: A year, from earlier billing on your beds. Worked out from your figures. The operation theatre is left out.

items.label: What it costs
items.sub: A year, for the two managers and three Admissions Executives. Discharge Executives are not in yet.

blocks.caption: Four numbers would finish the picture: the desk roster, hourly arrivals, bed transfers inside the hospital, and when discharges happen.
